findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_rounds · Private data: search_companies, list_my_lists · Public sink: search_companies, get_company, get_company_rounds, get_company_financials, search_rounds, get_investor, get_signals.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_rounds · Private data: search_companies, list_my_lists · Public sink: search_companies, get_company, get_company_rounds, get_company_financials, search_rounds, get_investor, get_signals

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
